title: Q-GROW-WEEKLY-REPORT: GROW-4: a weekly growth report loop: metric deltas and the next three experiments
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** file:ops/growth/weekly.json
**Status:** closed

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

The product manager's weekly loop: read growth metrics (foundation/growth.py), compute week-over-week deltas, list breaches, and write ops/growth/weekly.json with the next three experiments, each with a metric, a prediction and a closing probe, plus the keep-or-revert verdict for last week's experiments. Show it on /live.
Paths: foundation/growth.py, ops/growth/weekly.json, site/live.js, tests/foundation/test_growth.py.
Acceptance: a run writes the file; an experiment whose metric did not move in 7 days is replaced, not repeated.
Metric moved: all growth metrics.

size: M

**Closing probe:** file:ops/growth/weekly.json and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 219.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
